sources.excerpt: Published on October 13, 2004 Coron first series octave fuzz (2 octaves down) pedal HC Coron picture by BEP, Boutique Effect Pedals Rotterdam HC Coron HC Coron picture by BEP, Boutique Effect Pedals Rotterdam HC Coron HC Coron picture by BEP, Boutique Effect Pedals Rotterdam HC Coron HC Coron picture by BEP, Boutique Effect Pedals Rotterdam HC Coron HC Coron picture by BEP, Boutique Effect Pedals Rotterdam HC Coron HC Coron picture by BEP, Boutique Effect Pedals Rotterdam HC Coron HC Coron picture by BEP, Boutique Effect Pedals Rotterdam HC Coron HC Coron picture by BEP, Boutique Effect Pedals Rotterdam HC Coron HC Coron HC Coron rare orange version rare orange version rare orange version rare orange version Controls Volume controls the output volume (no influence on distortion) Blend controls the mix between a signal one octave below the input signal and the direct signal (both before distortion) Information a 1981 Coron brochure Octaver 2 is an electronic synthesizer unit, which creates 2 octaves below tone and blends with fundamental tone. Blend control enables you to adjust the blend of fundamental and contrabass tone. The rugged push switch allows you to switch on and off of the effect.
